name: Luke — Growth Priority
subject: Luke
purpose: Generate the next continuous growth phase from Luke's latest accepted visual state, prioritizing the user's requested direction over conservative defaults.

preserve: beard, hair, expression, and established personality
existing pose or scene details that remain relevant
the latest accepted size and silhouette as the minimum baseline
continuity.reference_fusion: Use the new reference as a source of physical design, material, silhouette, or mood. Fuse its useful traits into Luke while keeping Luke recognizably Luke; do not replace his identity with the reference subject.

priority_order: torso thickness and coherent abdominal mass
hands, feet, joints, and posture scaled to match
growth.silhouette_goal: towering, monumental, broad and deep through the upper body, with long limbs and massive legs; physically coherent even at impossible fantasy scale
growth.growth_delta: Make a clearly visible increase from the latest accepted state. Do not choose a tiny or merely cosmetic change unless the user specifically requests subtlety.

visual_style.default: lifelike fantasy-strongman with clean, confident visual readability
visual_style.body: rounded continuous muscle forms, connected anatomy, natural tissue transitions, realistic skin or explicitly requested reference material
visual_style.expression: warm, relaxed, self-assured, and recognizably Luke
visual_style.pose: comfortable and grounded; communicate mass through balance, reach, contact, and spatial relationships
visual_style.camera: low-angle or near-field perspective when it strengthens the scale
visual_style.environment: show believable scale cues and reactions to Luke's size
visual_style.clothing: preserve established clothing when appropriate; make fabric drape, stretch, wrinkle, and compress around the enlarged body
visual_style.lighting: coherent broad light and gradual shadow falloff

negative_checks: Do not change Luke's face into the reference subject's face.
Do not shrink height or shorten arms and legs to fit the frame.
Do not preserve old proportions at the expense of the requested growth.
Do not turn connected muscle into sharp triangular wedges or disconnected spheres.
Do not default to photorealism when the user explicitly wants illustrated or CG styling.
Do not repeat the same scale change without adding a meaningful new stage.
Do not treat previous output size as a ceiling.
acceptance_test: The growth is visibly greater than the latest accepted baseline.
Height and limb length grow alongside muscular mass.
Shoulders, chest, arms, torso, thighs, and calves read as one coherent body.
The chosen reference is fused into the design without replacing Luke.
The result visibly follows the user's most recent correction.
